remarks: Welcome to the beautiful community of Aurora! This exceptionally priced, 724 sq. ft. 2-bedroom condo on Main level offers a bright, modern open-concept layout connecting the kitchen, dining, and living areas. The kitchen is a standout feature, boasting upgraded maple cabinetry, stunning granite countertops, and a 5-piece stainless steel appliance package. Enjoy the convenience of an included surface parking stall. Location is everything—you're just moments from ETS transit, Walmart, and Superstore! Commuting is a breeze with the Anthony Henday few minutes away, the hospital just a 7-minute drive, and all the shopping at South Edmonton Common only 10 minutes away. Whether you’re a first-time homebuyer looking to enter the market or an investor seeking a prime rental property, this unit delivers unbeatable value! (id:67522)
